result.title: Gold has been surging in value. Why?
result.description:
The price of gold rose by 64% in 2025, reaching an all-time high in January 2026. What's behind the surge?

James Emmett, CEO of precious metals company MKS PAMP, says the key driver is uncertainty. Amid geopolitical and financial instability, central banks seek to boost their reserves of gold to protect against shocks. But why is #gold such a reliable ‘safe haven’ asset? Watch the video to find out.

From geopolitical uncertainty to the energy and digital transitions, minerals and metals are becoming increasingly central to the future of the global economy. The World Economic Forum’s Mining and Metals community brings leaders together to help the sector navigate these changes, strengthen its resilience and advance a responsible transformation. Learn more: https://www.weforum.org/communities/mining-and-metals/

result.title: Researchers sent this staple West African food into space. Here's why
result.description:
Egusi melon seeds are a staple in many West African cuisines – ground and cooked into protein-rich soups and stews. But in 2025, they encountered a whole other sort of dish…on a satellite.

Temidayo Oniosun, Managing Director of Space in Africa, was the driving force behind an initiative that saw egusi seeds placed aboard a SpaceX capsule with heritage crops from Egypt, Armenia and Pakistan.

The reason was twofold, he says: to spark interest in space launches across #Africa, and to see if the seeds were viable as future astronaut food. Here, he chats about the #mission and about Africa’s burgeoning space economy.

The World Economic Forum’s Future of Space Community brings industry experts together to explore the economic potential and responsible use of space technologies.

result.title: Demand for electricity is soaring: how can our power systems keep up?
result.description:
Global demand for electricity is soaring, as wars in Ukraine and Iran squeeze fossil fuel supply chains and the race for AI makes data centres a significant power consumer.

Divya Reddy, Manager of Energy Initiatives at the World Economic Forum sets out the challenge, and Varun Sivaram, Founder and CEO of Emerald AI explains how data centres can be made "good citizens to communities and power grids alike".

result.title: These CEOs have a climate message for leaders at COP31
result.description:
More than 100 CEOs have published an open letter ahead of November’s #COP31 meeting in Antalya, Türkiye.

The Alliance of CEO Climate Leaders has a clear message: the low-carbon transition is a strategic economic opportunity.

They are asking policy-makers for faster delivery, supported by stable, predictable and climate-science-aligned policy frameworks that unlock innovation, investment and market growth.

In this video, Alliance members explain why they felt compelled to take action - including Ester Baiget of Novonesis, Juvencio Maeztu of Ingka Group (IKEA), Roy Jakobs of Philips and World Economic Forum Managing Director Sebastian Buckup.
